instructions: Add an approved record only for a genuinely new indexable URL. Answer every field; do not use this as a keyword expansion queue.

approvals.userNeed: A beginner who knows what a sutta is still needs a practical method for identifying the source, reading its setting and structure, handling repetition, comparing translations, and forming a careful practice question.
approvals.intendedReader: Source-curious beginner moving from Buddhist summaries to direct sutta reading.
approvals.whyNotImproveExisting: The dictionary page owns concise definition intent. Turning it into a reading-method guide would blur its role, disturb an emerging query owner, and make the dictionary entry less concise.
approvals.uniqueValue: A reusable three-pass reading method, reference decoder, translation/commentary boundary, worked structural example, common-mistake review, and seven-question reading card.
approvals.sourceRequirements: Use SuttaCentral's introduction, getting-started material, reader guide, and SN 56.11 plus Access to Insight's Befriending the Suttas. Reproduce no modern translation and label Echo Buddha summaries and applications.
approvals.safetyRequirements: Educational source study only. Make no health, treatment, diagnosis, guaranteed-benefit, or personal-experience claims.
approvals.indexIntent: index, follow; self-canonical; include in sitemap and internal search through the existing Learn architecture.
approvals.monetizationSuitability: Suitable only under existing learning-page controls; no ad insertion inside source notes or study steps and AdSense runtime remains disabled.
approvals.nextStep: Continue to the sutta definition, Pali Canon definition, or one named source-study page and read the linked source beside the guide.
approvals.independentValueWithoutSearchOrAds: Yes. It gives existing Echo Buddha readers a practical way to verify and deepen the source-aware learning path even if the page receives no search traffic and carries no ads.
approvals.owner: Echo Buddha project owner via the 2026-08-21 growth-preserving expansion request
